Values.GITHUB_TOKEN: <optional: fine-grained token with public repo read, raises the rate limit>
Values.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: <required for Build Lab + chat: key from console.anthropic.com>
Values.ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY: <optional: Admin API key (sk-ant-admin...) so /admin shows Anthropic's real billed cost (facit) next to the estimate; a different key from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, made by an org admin in the Console>
Values.COSMOS_CONNECTION: <optional locally; in Azure: the Cosmos DB connection string. Empty = JSON files in api/.data>
Values.MEDIA_CONNECTION: <optional locally; in Azure: the Blob Storage connection string. Empty = files in api/.data/media>
Values.RESEND_API_KEY: <from resend.com, free tier; enables lead e-mails>
Values.LEAD_NOTIFY_EMAIL: <the address that should receive lead e-mails>
